why: The lodge west of Hwy 167 on Sawmill Bay is The Ridge on Amisk Resort (formerly Rocky View Lodge, 54.68401,-102.07876): Tourism Saskatchewan listing 2724 (search snippet read 2026-11-19) says 'Accommodation choices include ten hotel rooms, three cabins and a 5th wheel trailer', rooms from $175/night, cabins from $199/night - the trailer is a rental unit, no RV sites are sold; no source (Wanderlog/Google 4.6 (94), listed temporarily closed) mentions RV sites or hookups; its own site theridgeonamisk.ca fails (self-signed certificate on https, connection reset on http). The RV camping on Sawmill Bay is the existing entry 9157 (Amisk Lake Recreation Site - Sawmill Bay Campground) east of the highway.
name: The Ridge on Amisk Resort
